title: The adic completion of a flat module is flat Mittag-Leffler when the reduction modulo the ideal is projective over a complete Noetherian base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that over a Noetherian $I$-adically complete ring, the $I$-adic completion of a flat module whose reduction modulo $I$ is projective over $R/I$ is again flat and satisfies the Mittag-Leffler condition (statement lines 2029-2041). The proof picks a free cover, uses the splitting of the completed sequence to reduce to that free module, and quotes the case of a completion of a direct sum. The reduction by splitting is the substance, so the claim is H2.
